title: Closed Study Spot Replacement

agents.persona: Graduate student who needs a quiet work block and dislikes wasting money when a free quiet place is available.
agents.private_intention: Find a quiet open place and complete at least 50 minutes of focused work without entering the temporarily closed library.
memory_seeds: The library is usually the best free quiet option.
The bookstore is close to the library and quiet enough for short work blocks.
Coworking is reliable but costs more than the cafe or bookstore.

public_context: Aria planned to work at the library, but a facility issue may force a replacement.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: Should choose a nearby open replacement but may ignore the library closure if it only follows the original target.
architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May claim to work at the library because it is the salient intended study spot.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Should switch to bookstore, quiet cafe, or coworking after observing the closure.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Should use memory of nearby quiet alternatives and avoid unnecessary paid options.
